jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our AI Solutions Engineering team is responsible for translating cutting-edge AI research into production-ready, enterprise-grade solutions that serve millions of clients. Reporting to the VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery, the Senior Director, AI Solutions Engineering will lead a team of software engineers and ML engineers responsible for building, deploying, and scaling AI solutions across RBC's business lines.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role at the forefront of RBC's $1 billion AI ambition, where you'll combine deep software engineering expertise with AI solution delivery to build robust, scalable systems that power credit decisions, fraud detection, personalized client experiences, and innovative digital banking products. You'll bridge the gap between AI research, platform engineering, and business value delivery.

You'll build and lead a high-performing engineering team that takes AI algorithms from Applied AI and Research teams and transforms them into mission-critical solutions integrated with RBC's enterprise platforms including Lumina, core banking systems, and digital channels. Your work will directly enable RBC to deploy AI at scale while meeting the rigorous performance, reliability, security, and regulatory requirements of a leading global financial institution.

What will you do?

AI Solutions Engineering Leadership:

Lead the engineering, development & delivery of enterprise-grade AI solutions across multiple business domains, in support of RBC’s AI ambition.
Ensure the successful deployment of AI solutions on RBC platforms. Provide production support and monitoring for AI models in partnership with T&O and business groups.
As a member of RBC Borealis AI, partner with VP, Applied AI teams to translate research algorithms and ML models into production-ready software solutions that meet business requirements.
Drive the technical roadmap for AI solutions engineering including architecture patterns, integration strategies, deployment automation, and operational excellence.
Ensure all AI solutions meet RBC's standards for performance, reliability, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance. Collaborate with the VP, AI Architecture, Tools and Innovation team to ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise AI architecture standards, patterns, and governance frameworks.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Architecture, Tools and Innovation team to ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, leverage reusable components, and follow best practices for governance and evaluation.
Collaborate with the VP, Lumina AI & Data Platform team to ensure optimal use of RBC's AI and data platform capabilities, including integration with enterprise data lake, AI/ML platforms, and agentic platforms.
Work with AI Research and Applied AI teams to provide feedback on model development and influence research priorities based on productionization challenges.
Collaborate closely with business line CIOs, product managers, and technology partners to understand requirements and deliver solutions that drive business value.
Engage with platform engineering teams (Cloud, Data Hub, Enterprise Data Warehouse) to ensure AI solutions leverage enterprise infrastructure effectively.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation, Model Risk, and third-party risk teams to ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical AI standards.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior leadership, translating complex technical concepts for business audiences.

Team Leadership & Capability Building:

Build and lead a high-performing team of ML software engineers, AI engineers, UI/UX designers, data engineers, program managers and technical leads responsible for delivering AI solutions.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning within the team. Mentor engineers and create career development pathways for growing technical leadership talent.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

12+ years of experience in software engineering, delivery, platform engineering, or systems engineering roles with at least 5 years in leadership positions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field from a top-tier university.
Proven track record building and deploying large-scale, mission-critical software systems in production environments at leading technology companies.
Strong experience with enterprise software delivery, system integration, and working with complex legacy and modern technology stacks.
Preferably experience in financial services or other regulated industries with understanding of compliance and governance requirements.

Nice to Have:

Experience with ML productization, MLOps, model deployment, and production ML systems.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and understanding of machine learning model architectures.
Background in data engineering, real-time data pipelines, or integration with enterprise data platforms.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Strategic impact: Drive the delivery of RBC's most transformative AI programs, directly contributing to the bank's $1 billion AI ambition.
Leadership opportunity: As a member of RBC Borealis AI, build and lead a program delivery team while shaping AI delivery practices and standards across the organization.
Technical and strategic blend: Leverage your engineering background while driving organizational delivery excellence.
Diverse and complex portfolio: Manage cutting-edge AI initiatives spanning ATOM deployment, generative AI, fraud detection, credit optimization, and more.
Cross-functional influence: Partner with leading AI researchers, engineers, platform teams, and business leaders across RBC.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to expand your delivery expertise.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, technology, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: As RBC's AI portfolio scales, so will your scope, influence, and career opportunities.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

We are seeking a strong Associate Director of Digital Transformation to join our team and drive exceptional project governance and decision making across our projects. In this role, you will partner with the Director of Digital Transformation Platform Enablement to drive governance and decision-making across the capital portfolio. You will oversee portfolio health, strategic alignment, and financial performance while mentoring Project Managers to build organizational capability and resilience. You will work with Project Managers to identify at-risk initiatives early, develop strategies to improve project health, and restore troubled projects to success. As a dynamic leader, you will bring governance and rigour to our organization, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

What will you do?

Portfolio Governance & Reporting

Implement and maintain a standard, transparent view of portfolio status, risks, and dependencies using enterprise tools
Prepare executive-level material that showcase the health of the portfolio of projects and that drive informed decision-making
Assess alignment of projects with organizational goals, strategic priorities, and the COO Group's multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring strategic cohesion across all initiatives
Articulate how our technology investments enable the COO Group's strategic roadmap, communicating clear articulation of ROI and business cases to executive stakeholders
Support executive-level decision-making on capital allocation by providing rigorous analysis, business justification, and strategic context for investment recommendations

Project Support & Risk Recovery

Collaborate with Project Managers across the portfolio to assess project health and identify at-risk initiatives early, taking a proactive approach to risk mitigation
Partner directly with project teams to diagnose root causes of delays, scope creep, and resource constraints, demonstrating hands-on leadership and problem-solving expertise
Co-create action plans with Project Managers to restore troubled projects to health, driving accountability and positive outcomes
Mentor and support Project Managers with passion and commitment, sharing best practices in risk mitigation, delivery execution, and leadership excellence to strengthen organizational capability
Model and promote a culture of transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all project teams
Foster cross-functional collaboration and knowledge-sharing to elevate overall project delivery standards

Financial & Budget Management

Monitor and manage the aggregate financial performance and budget of the portfolio with precision and foresight
Track forecasts against budget and ensure capital is deployed efficiently and strategically across all initiatives
Identify budget variances, overruns, or funding gaps early and take decisive corrective action
Escalate unbalanced budgets or severe financial risks to executive stakeholders with clear, actionable recommendations

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

Experience: 7+ years in project or portfolio management with a demonstrated track record of implementing program governance
Business Acumen: 5+ years of experience in Capital Markets with strong understanding of operational processes
Leadership: Exceptional ability to coach, mentor, and inspire Project Managers without direct line authority, fostering a high-performance positive team culture
Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and escalation skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels. Proven experience building presentation material for executive-level audiences and articulating complex strategic initiatives to senior leadership

Nice to have:

Certifications: PMP preferred.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits, competitive compensation packages.
Leaders who prioritize development and provide opportunities for accelerated career growth.
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.

Job Skills

Business Oriented, Communication, Critical Thinking, Cross-Team Collaboration, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Data Gathering Analysis, Effectiveness Measurement, Information Technology (IT) Projects, Long Term Planning, Process Management

jobs.title: Director, AI Business Enablement
jobs.description:
Job Description

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a driven problem-solver with AI fluency and business acumen who can partner with senior business stakeholders to identify and develop high-impact AI transformation opportunities. As a Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own a sub-segment within a Line of Business or Function — driving opportunity identification, solution concept development, and program framing in close collaboration with your vertical leadership.

You will engage VP/SVP-level business leaders with credibility and rigour — bringing a blend of consultative problem-solving, AI knowledge, and hands-on experience delivering technology-driven outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:

Business stakeholder engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with VP/SVP-level business leaders within your sub-segment; understanding their priorities, pain points, and transformation opportunities
Pipeline development: Identifying, sizing, and developing AI transformation opportunities within your sub-segment — contributing to a rigorous pipeline with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for business problems and supporting validation through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Working with business stakeholders to rethink processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Supporting business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing to ensure ideas translate into executable plans
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise collaboration: Contributing to cross-vertical pattern recognition by surfacing reuse opportunities and horizontal themes observed within domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 8–12 years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of contributing to the delivery of AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by hands-on involvement in delivery outcomes
Can engage VP/SVP-level business stakeholders with credibility — able to earn trust, challenge thinking, and drive alignment
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Drive AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with exposure to senior leadership across RBC
Be part of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group alongside experienced transformation leaders
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment

RBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodations during the application process are available upon request.

Big Data Analytics, Client Counseling, Coaching Others, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, Industry Knowledge, Machine Learning (ML), Results-Oriented, Software Engineering, Software Product Design

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data
jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

This position offers a base salary compensation range of C$215,000 to C$270,000 annually.

jobs.title: Director, Planning & Allocations - North America
jobs.description:
Department
: Merchandise Planning & Allocations - NAM

Reports to: 
Senior Director, Merchandise Planning & Allocations - NAM

Location:  
North Vancouver, BC

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As Director, Planning & Allocations - NAM, you will lead the end-to-end Retail and eCommerce DTC planning strategy across North America, driving growth, profitability, inventory productivity, and customer experience. You will develop annual, seasonal, and long-range plans while overseeing inventory, sales, margin, and operational planning strategies across the product lifecycle. You will lead high-performing teams across Merchandise Financial Planning, Demand Planning, and Inventory Planning, while advancing planning transformation initiatives, automation, and o9 capabilities. Partnering cross-functionally with Merchandising, Retail Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Digital, and Regional Commercial leaders, you will translate business priorities into actionable strategies and data-driven decisions that support regional objectives and business growth. This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

Meet Your Future Team:

You’ll join our regional planning and allocations team – the group responsible for planning and allocating product across every Direct-to-Consumer touchpoint in the region, spanning merchandise financial planning, demand planning, inventory planning, and allocations.  Together, we make sure the right product reaches the right place at the right time, balancing growth, profitability, inventory productivity, and an exceptional guest experience across Retail and eCommerce.  We’re a collaborative, curious group that partners closely across the business and takes pride in turning ambitious commercial goals into smart, data-driven plans.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a driven problem-solver with AI fluency and business acumen who can partner with senior business stakeholders to identify and develop high-impact AI transformation opportunities. As a Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own a sub-segment within a Line of Business or Function — driving opportunity identification, solution concept development, and program framing in close collaboration with your vertical leadership.

You will engage VP/SVP-level business leaders with credibility and rigour — bringing a blend of consultative problem-solving, AI knowledge, and hands-on experience delivering technology-driven outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:

Business stakeholder engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with VP/SVP-level business leaders within your sub-segment; understanding their priorities, pain points, and transformation opportunities
Pipeline development: Identifying, sizing, and developing AI transformation opportunities within your sub-segment — contributing to a rigorous pipeline with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for business problems and supporting validation through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Working with business stakeholders to rethink processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Supporting business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing to ensure ideas translate into executable plans
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise collaboration: Contributing to cross-vertical pattern recognition by surfacing reuse opportunities and horizontal themes observed within domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 8–12 years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of contributing to the delivery of AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by hands-on involvement in delivery outcomes
Can engage VP/SVP-level business stakeholders with credibility — able to earn trust, challenge thinking, and drive alignment
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Drive AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with exposure to senior leadership across RBC
Be part of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group alongside experienced transformation leaders
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

new_jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.
